Theme

Body, health & movement · Conversation, family & daily routines

pain noun

also ache, hurt, aches, severe pain, distress, feel pain

classical

Cic. Tusc. 2.35 (Lewis & Short, “dolor est motus asper in corpore”)
Lucr. 6.785: capitis
Andresian p. 36
Traupman 62
Traupman 65: ingēns (vehemēns) dolor, severe pain
Traupman 151

dolor, dolōris m.

noun, third declension

pain, ache; grief

Pain of the body (dolor capitis, dentium) and of the mind. It hurts: dolet; my head hurts: caput mihi dolet.

Other words

  • dolōre afficī — to feel pain, be pained

    also used · classical · Caes. BG 1.2.4: magnō dolōre afficī (Lewis & Short); Traupman 152

Examples

  • Caput mihi dolet.

    My head hurts.composed

  • Ubi tibi dolet?

    Where does it hurt?composed

See also tummy ache, headache, toothache, sadness.

Anna Andresian, Vocabula Picta (2014), p. 36.
